run_spm_train: run the script to train a SentencePiece model using command-line arguments
run_sentencepiece_training: run SentencePieceTrainer.Train with arguments passed via sys.argv to build a tokenizer model
review_spm_train: review the spm_train script that wraps SentencePieceTrainer.Train for CLI usage
summarize_spm_train: summarize the spm_train script which forwards all CLI args to sentencepiece training
refactor_spm_train: refactor the spm_train script to add argparse instead of raw sys.argv joining
